name: gormapper-overlay
description: Transparent click-through Electron overlay that draws GORMAPPER zones on top of the real projector desktop

scripts.dist: electron-packager . GORMAPPER --out=pack-out --overwrite && mkdir -p ../dist && rm -rf ../dist/GORMAPPER.app && mv pack-out/GORMAPPER-darwin-*/GORMAPPER.app ../dist/ && rm -rf pack-out && echo 'packaged: ../dist/GORMAPPER.app'
